author: Hannah Woodard
body: Bought the guide for my 8 month old who had to be nursed to sleep every sleep cycle (some nights every 1.5hrs) took 2 days for our baby to sleep through the night. I was amazed at the amount of options she gave based on your comfort level and baby’s personality. There is something for EVERY baby. She saved my sanity and my toddler got his fun, and patient mom back during the day. Worth every penny.
